needsCoreFeature: Pediatric accident event and parent/guardian notification task completion
notes: Opened 2026-10-31: Cornell LII reproduction of CCR Title 22, Division 5, Chapter 1. LII says updates are quarterly but supplies no as-of date for this text; official Westlaw currency not confirmed. Verified means the quoted regulatory text was opened and matched, not a certification of currentness. The legal duty is actual notification; an alert alone is insufficient. No numeric deadline or alert tier is specified. Hospital pediatric service only.

title: Newborn oxygen requires written physician order
quote: Oxygen shall be administered to newborn infants only on the written order of a physician.
proposedRule: Before giving oxygen to a newborn, require a written physician order.
needsCoreFeature: Newborn oxygen workflow with physician-authored written order verification
notes: Opened 2026-10-31: Cornell LII reproduction of CCR Title 22, Division 5, Chapter 1. LII says updates are quarterly but supplies no as-of date for this text; official Westlaw currency not confirmed. Verified means the quoted regulatory text was opened and matched, not a certification of currentness. Perinatal-unit requirement. P3/P4 are relevant nursing/pediatric workflow analogues; the NP persona does not replace the specifically named physician. v1 has neither a newborn-oxygen condition nor this order check.

title: Newborn oxygen order specifies concentration or target
quote: The order shall include the concentration (volume percent) or desired arterial partial pressure of oxygen
proposedRule: Require either volume-percent oxygen concentration or desired arterial oxygen partial pressure on each newborn oxygen order.
needsCoreFeature: Newborn oxygen order with alternative typed concentration/arterial-pressure target
notes: Opened 2026-10-31: Cornell LII reproduction of CCR Title 22, Division 5, Chapter 1. LII says updates are quarterly but supplies no as-of date for this text; official Westlaw currency not confirmed. Verified means the quoted regulatory text was opened and matched, not a certification of currentness. One alternative-valued order requirement, not two simultaneous mandatory values. Ordinary medication dose in milligrams cannot represent it. Perinatal-unit scope.

proposedRule: Track newborn oxygen orders for review, modification or discontinuation after 24 hours.
needsCoreFeature: Newborn oxygen order age and review/modify/discontinue lifecycle
notes: Opened 2026-10-31: Cornell LII reproduction of CCR Title 22, Division 5, Chapter 1.
